name: Gods Character
overview: God's character is revealed as unchanging and perfect, demonstrated by His consistent nature and the goodness from which all blessings flow, as stated in James 1:17 and Hebrews 13:8. His love is supremely shown in the giving of His only Son for eternal life to believers, highlighting the centrality of love in His nature (John 3:16). Furthermore, the fruit of the Spirit—love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, and faith—reflects the qualities inherent in God's character as He works within believers (Galatians 5:22).
